title: Some binary operations resist generalization
description: Certain operations (e.g., x^3+xy^2+y mod 97) did not lead to generalization within the allowed optimization budget at any training data percentage up to 95%, with models merely memorizing the training data.
canonical_description: some binary operations resisted generalization within the optimization budget and data fraction range tested

evidence.quote: Some operations (for example $x^3+xy^2+y \pmod {97}$) didn't lead to generalization within the allowed optimization budget at any percentage of data up to 95%.
